limitations.note: The default waveform matches the reference, but rewriting both duty-cycle comparisons and widening the counters changes behavior for parameter overrides that the one-line fix leaves intact.
The default test could catch the original bug, but the parameterized test assumed the rewritten duty-cycle rule and therefore accepted a nine-cycle high pulse where the reference rule gives six.
